**Leo Zugner** is an industrial designer who worked at Mattel from 2012 to 2019. He was involved with the Hot Wheels Advanced Play department, designing new products for Hot Wheels's "future of play". He is known for the design of some [Sky Busters](/wiki/Sky_Busters) models and the [Hot Wheels id](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_id) line, particularly the loop section in the [Smart Track Kit](/wiki/Smart_Track_Kit) as well as the [Race Portal](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_id_Race_Portal). Prior to joining Mattel, he was a designer for competing brand Jakks Pacific as well as [Future Elements](/wiki/Dwayne_Vance) and Lanard Toys. He currently works at Salient Technologies.
